PROJECT NOVA — Confidential Engineering Challenge
A fictional technology company is choosing an electric vehicle prototype for a fleet of 120 vehicles.
Five prototypes are available:
Prototype | Cost per vehicle | Range | Charging time | Defect rate | Weight
Aster | $460 | 390 km | 22 min | 1.0% | 205 kg
Boreal | $515 | 430 km | 18 min | 1.8% | 210 kg
Cinder | $495 | 420 km | 16 min | 0.9% | 235 kg
Dawn | $540 | 445 km | 19 min | 1.1% | 215 kg
Eclipse | $505 | 410 km | 20 min | 1.2% | 198 kg
Company Requirements
To qualify, a prototype must meet ALL requirements:
1. Driving range must be at least 410 km.
2. Charging time must be no more than 20 minutes.
3. Defect rate must be no higher than 1.2%.
4. Vehicle weight must not exceed 220 kg.
5. Total fleet cost must stay within $62,000.
Financial Rules
- The company must purchase exactly 120 identical vehicles.
- Orders of at least 100 vehicles receive a 10% discount on the vehicle purchase price.
- Shipping costs an additional $2,500 per fleet order.
- No other discounts or fees apply.
- If multiple prototypes qualify, choose the one with the lowest total fleet cost.
CHALLENGE
Determine which prototype the company should purchase.
Explain:
- Which prototypes fail the requirements and why.
- Which prototypes qualify.
- The total fleet cost after discount and shipping for every technically qualified prototype.
- How much money remains from the $62,000 budget.
- Why your final choice is better than the alternatives.
Show your calculations clearly. Use only the information in this document.
